_comment: Example --dart-define-from-file for the Flutter app. PUBLIC values only: everything here is compiled into the app and can be extracted from the APK/IPA. Never put secrets, API keys with write access or settlement data here. Copy to dart_defines.json (git-ignored; CI secret guard refuses it if committed) and run: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines.json. Names must match String.fromEnvironment(...) in the app — coordinate with the mobile engineer before renaming. Legal page URLs are placeholders until apps/web publishes those routes; ACCOUNT_DELETION_URL (/jastipkita/akun/hapus/) is the one declared to Google Play.
